comment: Pinned commit of the upstream sources vendored into tools/tsc-ast/upstream, which mirrors the upstream directory layout. Bump `ref` (or pass --ref) and run `dotnet fsi tools/generate-wire.fsx sync tsc-ast` to resync.

sources.comment: The AST schema and the generators read by tools/tsc-ast/generate-ast.mts.
The binary format itself. encoder.go documents every section at :72-200, and is the only statement anywhere of the SourceFile extended-data record; generate-ast.mts parses that table.
The reader side of the same format: the data-word masks and section offsets that Ast in Library.fs is written against.

The flag and kind enums the checker answers with. Upstream generates these from tsc/internal/**/*.go and commits them, so they are transcribed from a generated file rather than parsed out of Go. syntaxKind is vendored as an oracle: generate-enums.mts diffs it against the SyntaxKind that generate-ast.mts derives positionally from ast.json.
